property_summary: With a single recipient in _tos, P.transfer makes one call and returns true, while M.transfer skips the only iteration (0 < 0 is false) and returns true without reverting; the difference is that M's transfer returns true but did not call caddress.transferFrom, so the recipient's balance (observed via a public getter) is zero under M but nonzero under P.
change_summary: Change the loop condition to i < _tos.length - 1, so the last iteration is skipped and fewer calls succeed.
